newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa bonds firm on short-covering, rand steady.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa bonds firm on short-covering, rand steady.

text.p: 1007 GMT - Bonds strong at noon following short-covering by jobbers and local and offshore buying. Rand steady in dull trade.

* Key R150 at 14.73 pct from 14.86 pct on Friday. Dealers say short-covering, triggered by better-than-expected private sector credit figure on Friday, helps yields lower in active morning session. Market also seeing local institutional and foreign demand amid earlier talk of more Eurorand issues in the system.

* European Investment Bank announces shortly before 1000 GMT that it has launched 200 million rand, three-year issue, while Bank Nederlandse Gemeenten follows shortly afterwards with 2.5 billion and 4.0 billion rand zero coupon bonds.
* Market eyeing release of U.S. first quarter employment cost index and March durable goods data at 1230 GMT to see what impact it has on U.S. T-bond, which last trading at 7.13 pct yield.
* R150 seen in 14.75 to 14.65 pct range in afternoon.
* Rand at 4.4430/4460 on dollar from 4.4510/4540 on Friday in quiet two-way trade. Seen in 4.44 to 4.45 range in afternoon.
